Short (30 PDF pages) benchmarking booklet. Loaded: the model (best-practice) kraft market pulp mill by area (Tables I-III, steam GJ/ADt and electricity kWh/ADt), the model TMP mill (Table IV), the model DIP mill (text p.16), the model newsprint machine (Table V) and the three model integrated newsprint mills (Tables VI-VII). An O2 delignification + ECF bleaching example was summed from two model-mill areas (formula). Steam in the model-mill tables is steam energy (GJ), not boiler fuel. Not loaded into main: Swedish/Finnish comparison values and CPPA 1999 existing-mill statistics (other-values), and Figures 1-7 (mill-by-mill bars, no printed values; quartiles not printed). Locator: printed booklet page numbers (pp.5-28). Traps: p.9 text gives evaporator electricity as 30.0 GJ/ADt (typo; Table I 30 kWh/ADt used); the TMP mill is a net steam producer (-5.5 GJ/ADt), loaded as a steam output flow; many model-area values are reprinted from Nilsson et al. 1995 (ACEEE) and Jackson and Wild 1999.
